title: Rabbi Pedat the Elder
author: Aharon Hyman
attribution: Model-assisted translation, editorially reviewed; publication authorized by Joshua Waxman.
copyright: English translation and editorial notes © 2026 Joshua Waxman. All rights reserved.
paragraphs: He is mentioned in Tikkunei Zohar 29, and Rabbi Elazar son of Rabbi Shimon said of him that he is a completely righteous man.
Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon, part 1, beginning of chapter 2, likewise mentions Rabbi Pedat the earlier, of the generation before Rabbi.
Yuchasin presents Rabbi Pedat as a colleague of Rabbi who lived a long life. Its reading of Moed Katan 25b was: “When Rabbi Pedat died, his grandson Rabbi Pedat eulogized him.”

notes.text: The long-lived Pedat, Rabbi’s colleague, and the same-named grandson are Hyman’s claims. His reported Yuchasin reading is preserved without merging it with other Pedat entries.

The consulted Constantinople Tikkunei Zohar text, 100a, includes Rabbi Elazar’s statement that Rabbi Pedat was completely righteous. Hyman’s locator 29 is retained; its exact numbering scheme is unverified. This occurrence does not establish his identification of the Elder, generation, longevity or same-named grandson reported from Iggeret Rav Sherira Gaon and Yuchasin.
